player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Su giogadore at proadu a retzire unu cummèrtziu sena tènnere sas risorsas netzessàrias.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Giogadore {player_id}, Atzu ineitzu. Colonna {col} est foras de sos limites.
invalid_move.already_full: Giogadore {player_id}, Atzu ineitzu. Colonna {col} est plena.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Giogadore {player_id} at chircadu de fàghere un'oferta cumertziale sena tènnere sas risorsas netzessàrias.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Giogadore {player_id} at fatu un'oferta de cummèrtziu in unu formadu no curretu.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Su giogadore {player_id} no at fatu peruna oferta noa de cummèrtziu.

offers.reject: Giogadore {player_id} at refudadu s'oferta de cummèrtziu.
offers.accept: Giogadore {acceptor_id} at acollidu s'oferta de scambiu de Giogadore {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Giogadore {player_id} at fattu s'oferta sighente a Giogadore {opponent_id}: Benes offeridos: {offered} -> Benes domandados: {requested}

outcome.win: Giogadore {winner_id} at bintu tenende unu guadagnamentu prus mannu in su balore de s'inventàriu.
outcome.draw: Su matessi cambiamentu in su balore de s'inventàriu pro totu sos giogadores.
